content.text: In many regions, digital creators face barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-software-without-stripe-account-which-architecture-actually-4|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-what-actually-how-8|Selling Design]] products online due to restrictions imposed by platforms like Stripe and PayPal. Countries such as Nigeria and Venezuela are often excluded from using these conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-stack-started-generating|payment]] processors, leaving creators in the lurch. Fortunately, a different approach exists that empowers you to build your own digital commerce infrastructure without relying on these platforms. By using tools like NOWPayments, Cloudflare, and Google Apps Script, you can establish a fully operational online store that processes payments in cryptocurrency, ensuring you keep more of your revenue and maintain complete control over your products.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

This infrastructure stands strong where platforms falter because it prioritizes sovereignty and control. Conventional platforms like Gumroad impose hefty fees, often around 10% per transaction, which can severely cut into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, meaning that for 100 sales per month of a $97 product, you retain an additional $921. This difference enables you to reinvest more into your business, grow your product offerings, and ultimately increase your reach without the risk of being locked out of the market.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deploying your digital commerce stack, ensure you have several key components ready. First, create accounts on platforms like GitHub and Cloudflare, which will host your website and manage your backend logic. Then set up an account with NOWPayments for seamless transaction processing. Additionally, consider how you will store your products—using Supabase or Google Sheets works effectively for order management. Lastly, have your digital products ready, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, as you will need to upload them for immediate delivery.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Establishing your payment and delivery pipeline is straightforward. Start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you specify the networks with low fees, like BSC or Solana. Next, integrate NOWPayments with your site using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which will handle payment verification and product delivery automatically. This integration allows for instant access to digital products upon successful payment. By mapping out this pipeline effectively, you streamline the transactional experience for your customers.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Launch your website hosted on GitHub or Cloudflare, and ensure all links to your payment system are working correctly. Promote your store through social media and other channels to attract customers. The moment a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will handle the transaction, verifying it on-chain and triggering the product delivery mechanism you’ve established. This seamless process not only provides a smooth experience for buyers but also builds trust in your brand.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your infrastructure is operational, focus on scaling your efforts. Begin by analyzing customer data to understand purchasing patterns and preferences. Use this information to expand your product offerings, whether it’s additional courses or more templates. Leverage the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access advanced blueprints and templates that can enhance your existing stack. Continuous testing and refinement of your pipeline will ensure that as your sales increase, your infrastructure remains robust, handling increased traffic and transactions effortlessly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
You retain full ownership and control of your digital products after deployment.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For creators looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), packed with essential blueprints and templates to help you build and scale your sovereign commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for instant access to these resources.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook online by creating your own ecommerce site using platforms like GitHub for hosting and NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. This eliminates the need for traditional payment processors.

Utilizing a sovereign commerce stack with NOWPayments allows you to avoid hefty platform fees. By hosting your store independently, you keep more of your profits.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By deploying your own ecommerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers, ensuring you maintain full control over your products and transactions.
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my ecommerce site?
Integrate NOWPayments by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment processing. Follow the integration guide provided by NOWPayments for a seamless setup.
What payment cryptocurrencies can I accept?
You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, including popular choices like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, ensuring you cater to a wide audience.
